## Data wrangling & calc

```{r data-wrangling-and-calc, echo=TRUE}
#PDtree <- phy_tree(ps_rare)
otu <- otu_table(ps_final)
otu <- as.data.frame(t(otu))

alpha.pd.sr<-otu


#Adding vector to summarize replicates
alpha.pd.sr$site <- sample_data(ps_final)$Site_ID
alpha.pd.sr$taxa <- sample_data(ps_final)$Taxa
alpha.pd.sr$lifestage <- sample_data(ps_final)$Lifestage
alpha.pd.sr$location<- sample_data(ps_final)$Location
alpha.pd.sr$city<- sample_data(ps_final)$Site
alpha.pd.sr$sample_type<- sample_data(ps_final)$Sample_Type
#---------------------------------------------------
#### Eveness
alpha_diversity <- estimate_richness(ps_final, measure = c("Shannon", "Observed"))
alpha_diversity
H <- alpha_diversity$Shannon
S1 <- alpha_diversity$Observed
S <- log(S1)
eveness <- H/S
#eveness
alpha.pd.sr$Evenness = eveness


alpha.pd.sr$site<-factor(alpha.pd.sr$site, levels=c("WAT_DWN","WAT_UP","HESP_UP","HESP_DWN","CAL_UP","CAL_DWN","KIT_UP", "KIT_DWN" ))

alpha.pd.sr$taxa<-factor(alpha.pd.sr$taxa, levels=c("Hydropsychidae", "Chironomidae", "Heptageniidae", "Araneid", "Tetragnatha"))

alpha.pd.sr$location<-factor(alpha.pd.sr$location, levels=c("UP", "DWN" ))
```

## Statistics - Wilcoxon

checking if diversity differed significantly between sites

```{r Statistical-tests, cache=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
alpha.pd.sr %>% 
  group_by(city, location, sample_type) %>%
  get_summary_stats(Shannon, type = "common")

# Filter out groups with only one site and nest data for grouped testing
alpha_grouped <- alpha.pd.sr %>%
  group_by(city, sample_type) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(site) > 1) %>%
  nest()

# Apply Wilcoxon tests across groups using purrr::map
wilcox_results <- alpha_grouped %>%
  mutate(
    pwc_Even = map(data, ~ wilcox_test(.x, Evenness ~ site, p.adjust.method = "BH")),
    pwc_Shan = map(data, ~ wilcox_test(.x, Shannon ~ site, p.adjust.method = "BH"))
  )

# Unnest and write output
pwc_Even <- wilcox_results %>%
  select(city, sample_type, pwc_Even) %>%
  unnest(pwc_Even)

pwc_Shan <- wilcox_results %>%
  select(city, sample_type, pwc_Shan) %>%
  unnest(pwc_Shan)

# Export results to CSV
readr::write_csv(pwc_Even, file.path(output_dir, "wilcoxon_results_evenness.csv"))
readr::write_csv(pwc_Shan, file.path(output_dir, "wilcoxon_results_shannon.csv"))

# Save csv
readr::write_csv(alpha.pd.sr, file.path(output_dir, "alphadiversity_results.csv"))

```

# Compare Life stages

```{r alpha-diversity-location-by-taxon-lifestage, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}


# Alpha diversity (macroinvertebrates only): UP vs DWN
# Facet by Taxa and Lifestage (no site-level stratification)


#Build alpha diversity table 
alpha_div <- estimate_richness(ps_final, measures = c("Shannon", "Observed")) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Study_ID")

#  Add metadata
meta_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_final)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Study_ID")

alpha_df <- alpha_div %>%
  left_join(meta_df, by = "Study_ID") %>%
  mutate(
    # Evenness = Shannon / ln(Species richness)
    Evenness = ifelse(Observed > 1, Shannon / log(Observed), NA_real_),
    Location = factor(Location, levels = c("UP", "DWN")),
    Taxa = factor(Taxa),
    Lifestage = factor(Lifestage)
  )

# exclude spiders)
macro_taxa <- c("Hydropsychidae", "Chironomidae", "Heptageniidae")
alpha_macro <- alpha_df %>%
  filter(Taxa %in% macro_taxa) %>%
  mutate(
    Taxa = factor(Taxa, levels = macro_taxa),
    Lifestage = factor(Lifestage, levels = c("Larvae", "Adult"))
  )


# Plot:evenness by Location, faceted by Taxa + Lifestage
p_even_loc <- ggplot(alpha_macro, aes(x = Location, y = Evenness, fill = Location)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0),
    size = 1.6, alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  facet_nested_wrap(~ Taxa + Lifestage, nrow = 1, scales = "fixed") +
  labs(
    x = "Location",
    y = "Evenness (Shannon / ln(Observed))",
    title = "Alpha diversity (Evenness) by location across macroinvertebrate taxa and life stages"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 11),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 6), face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 6), face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p_even_loc

# Save
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "Evenness_macro_byLocation_taxa_lifestage.pdf"),
       plot = p_even_loc, height = 5.5, width = 14)
ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "Evenness_macro_byLocation_taxa_lifestage.png"),
       plot = p_even_loc, height = 5.5, width = 14, dpi = 300)


# Shannon and Observed in the same style


p_shannon_loc <- ggplot(alpha_macro, aes(x = Location, y = Shannon, fill = Location)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0), size = 1.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_nested_wrap(~ Taxa + Lifestage, nrow = 1, scales = "fixed") +
  labs(x = "Location", y = "Shannon", title = "Alpha diversity (Shannon) by location") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 6), face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 6), face = "bold", size = 14),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p_observed_loc <- ggplot(alpha_macro, aes(x = Location, y = Observed, fill = Location)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0), size = 1.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_nested_wrap(~ Taxa + Lifestage, nrow = 1, scales = "fixed") +
  labs(x = "Location", y = "Observed ASVs", title = "Alpha diversity (Observed) by location") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 6), face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 6), face = "bold", size = 14),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# Save 
ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "Shannon_macro_byLocation_taxa_lifestage.pdf"),
       plot = p_shannon_loc, height = 5.5, width = 14)
ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "Shannon_macro_byLocation_taxa_lifestage.png"),
       plot = p_shannon_loc, height = 5.5, width = 14, dpi = 300)

ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "Observed_macro_byLocation_taxa_lifestage.pdf"),
       plot = p_observed_loc, height = 5.5, width = 14)
ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "Observed_macro_byLocation_taxa_lifestage.png"),
       plot = p_observed_loc, height = 5.5, width = 14, dpi = 300)

```

## Stats compare larvae vs adults

```{r}


alpha_metrics <- c("Evenness", "Shannon", "Observed")

# Keep only larval/adult macroinvertebrates, drop missing metrics
alpha_stats_df <- alpha_macro %>%
  filter(Lifestage %in% c("Larvae", "Adult")) %>%
  drop_na(any_of(alpha_metrics)) %>%
  mutate(
    Taxa = factor(Taxa),
    Lifestage = factor(Lifestage, levels = c("Larvae", "Adult"))
  )


print(table(alpha_stats_df$Taxa, alpha_stats_df$Lifestage))


# Wilcoxon tests: Larvae vs Adult within each Taxa (for each metric)
alpha_lifestage_stats <- alpha_stats_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(alpha_metrics),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Taxa, Metric) %>%
  rstatix::wilcox_test(
    formula = Value ~ Lifestage,
    detailed = TRUE,
    exact = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr"),
    significance = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ "ns"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Taxa, Metric, n1, n2, statistic, p, p_adj, significance)

alpha_lifestage_stats

write.csv(
  alpha_lifestage_stats,
  file = file.path(output_dir, "AlphaDiversity_Larvae_vs_Adult_byTaxon_Wilcoxon.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Effect sizes (Cliff's delta) per Taxa and metric
alpha_lifestage_effects <- alpha_stats_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(alpha_metrics),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Taxa, Metric) %>%
  rstatix::wilcox_effsize(
    formula = Value ~ Lifestage,
    ci = TRUE
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # 'effsize' is Cliff's delta for wilcox_effsize()
  select(Taxa, Metric, effsize, magnitude, conf.low, conf.high)

alpha_lifestage_effects

write.csv(
  alpha_lifestage_effects,
  file = file.path(output_dir, "AlphaDiversity_Larvae_vs_Adult_byTaxon_EffectSizes.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r alpha-diversity-stats-location-by-taxon-lifestage, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  rstatix::wilcox_test(
    formula = Value ~ Location,

    exact = FALSE

alpha_location_stats
```

```{r alpha-diversity-spiders-up-vs-dwn, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggh4x)
library(rstatix)


# Build alpha table 
alpha_div <- estimate_richness(ps_final, measures = c("Shannon", "Observed")) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Study_ID")

meta_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_final)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Study_ID")

alpha_df <- alpha_div %>%
  left_join(meta_df, by = "Study_ID") %>%
  mutate(
    Evenness = ifelse(Observed > 1, Shannon / log(Observed), NA_real_),
    Location = factor(Location, levels = c("UP", "DWN")),
    Taxa = factor(Taxa),
    Lifestage = factor(Lifestage)
  )

alpha_metrics <- c("Evenness", "Shannon", "Observed")



# Subset spiders
spider_taxa <- c("Araneid", "Tetragnatha")

alpha_spider <- alpha_df %>%
  filter(
    Taxa %in% spider_taxa,
    Location %in% c("UP", "DWN")
  ) %>%
  drop_na(any_of(alpha_metrics)) %>%
  mutate(
    Taxa = factor(Taxa, levels = spider_taxa),
    Location = factor(Location, levels = c("UP", "DWN"))
  )

# Sanity check
print(table(alpha_spider$Taxa, alpha_spider$Location))


# P vs DWN within each spider taxon (per metric)
spider_location_stats <- alpha_spider %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(alpha_metrics),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Taxa, Metric) %>%
  rstatix::wilcox_test(
    formula = Value ~ Location,
    detailed = TRUE,
    exact = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr"),
    significance = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ "ns"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Taxa, Metric, n1, n2, statistic, p, p_adj, significance)

spider_location_stats

write.csv(

  file = file.path(output_dir, "AlphaDiversity_Spiders_UP_vs_DWN_byTaxon.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Plots spiders UP vs DWN (one panel per metric; facet by Taxa)
plot_spider_alpha <- function(metric_name, y_label) {
  ggplot(alpha_spider, aes(x = Location, y = .data[[metric_name]], fill = Location)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.65, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.12), size = 1.8, alpha = 0.7) +
    facet_nested_wrap(~ Taxa, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      x = "Location",
      y = y_label,
      title = paste0("Spiders: ", y_label, " by location (UP vs DWN)")
    ) +

      axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 6)),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}
```

# Improved plotting of Alpha diversity for macroinverts

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggh4x)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(rlang)



# label df for stat_pvalue_manual (macro)
prep_pval_df_macro <- function(stats_df, plot_df, metric_name,
                               offset_frac = 0.06, min_offset = NULL) {

  y_df <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(Taxa, Lifestage) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      y_min = min(.data[[metric_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
      y_max = max(.data[[metric_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      y_range  = pmax(y_max - y_min, 0),
      y_offset = offset_frac * y_range,
      y_offset = if (!is.null(min_offset)) pmax(y_offset, min_offset) else y_offset,
      y.position = y_max + y_offset
    )

  stats_df %>%
    filter(Metric == metric_name) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      group1 = "UP",
      group2 = "DWN",
      label  = significance
    ) %>%
    left_join(y_df, by = c("Taxa", "Lifestage")) %>%
    select(Taxa, Lifestage, group1, group2, y.position, label)
}


# Plot function: macroinvertebrates with stats
plot_macro_alpha_with_stats <- function(metric_name, y_label,
                                        plot_df = alpha_loc_df,
                                        stats_df = alpha_location_stats,
                                        offset_frac = 0.06,
                                        min_offset = NULL) {

  pvals <- prep_pval_df_macro(stats_df, plot_df, metric_name,
                             offset_frac = offset_frac,
                             min_offset = min_offset)
  y_var <- rlang::sym(metric_name)

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Location, y = !!y_var, fill = Location)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.65, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.12), size = 1.6, alpha = 0.7) +
    facet_nested(rows = vars(Taxa), cols = vars(Lifestage), scales = "free_y") +
    ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
      pvals,
      label = "label",
      xmin = "group1",
      xmax = "group2",
      y.position = "y.position",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      size = 5
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.12))) +
    labs(
      x = "Location",
      y = y_label,
      title = paste0(y_label, " (macroinvertebrates): UP vs DWN")
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}


# Create plots (tweak offset_frac if needed)
p_macro_even <- plot_macro_alpha_with_stats("Evenness", "Evenness",
                                            offset_frac = 0.05, min_offset = 0.01)

p_macro_shan <- plot_macro_alpha_with_stats("Shannon", "Shannon diversity",
                                            offset_frac = 0.05)

p_macro_obs  <- plot_macro_alpha_with_stats("Observed", "Observed ASV richness",
                                            offset_frac = 0.05)

# Show
p_macro_even
p_macro_shan
p_macro_obs


# Save plots (PNG + PDF
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "Alpha_Macro_Evenness_UP_vs_DWN_stats.png"),
       plot = p_macro_even, width = 9, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "Alpha_Macro_Shannon_UP_vs_DWN_stats.png"),
       plot = p_macro_shan, width = 9, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "Alpha_Macro_Observed_UP_vs_DWN_stats.png"),
       plot = p_macro_obs, width = 9, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "Alpha_Macro_Evenness_UP_vs_DWN_stats.pdf"),
       plot = p_macro_even, width = 9, height = 6.5)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "Alpha_Macro_Shannon_UP_vs_DWN_stats.pdf"),
       plot = p_macro_shan, width = 9, height = 6.5)

ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "Alpha_Macro_Observed_UP_vs_DWN_stats.pdf"),
       plot = p_macro_obs, width = 9, height = 6.5)

```

# Improved plotting alpha diversity Spiders

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggh4x)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(rlang)

prep_pval_df_spider <- function(stats_df, plot_df, metric_name,
                                offset_frac = 0.06, min_offset = NULL) {

  y_df <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(Taxa) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      y_min = min(.data[[metric_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
      y_max = max(.data[[metric_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      y_range  = pmax(y_max - y_min, 0),
      y_offset = offset_frac * y_range,
      y_offset = if (!is.null(min_offset)) pmax(y_offset, min_offset) else y_offset,
      y.position = y_max + y_offset
    )

  stats_df %>%
    filter(Metric == metric_name) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      group1 = "UP",
      group2 = "DWN",
      label  = significance   # or: paste0("FDR=", signif(p_adj, 2))
    ) %>%
    left_join(y_df, by = "Taxa") %>%
    select(Taxa, group1, group2, y.position, label)
}



plot_spider_alpha_with_stats <- function(metric_name, y_label,
                                         plot_df = alpha_spider,
                                         stats_df = spider_location_stats,
                                         offset_frac = 0.06,
                                         min_offset = NULL) {

  pvals <- prep_pval_df_spider(stats_df, plot_df, metric_name,
                               offset_frac = offset_frac,
                               min_offset = min_offset)
  y_var <- rlang::sym(metric_name)

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Location, y = !!y_var, fill = Location)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.65, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.12), size = 1.6, alpha = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~ Taxa, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
      pvals,
      label = "label",
      xmin = "group1",
      xmax = "group2",
      y.position = "y.position",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      size = 5
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.12))) +
    labs(
      x = "Location",
      y = y_label,
      title = paste0("Spiders: ", y_label, " (UP vs DWN)")
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}
```
